title: ModelSheetColumn
description: Canonical JSON contract for a normalized sheet column in jocaagura_domain.

name.description: Unique column name that also acts as the key used inside row data objects.

type.description: Canonical data type expected for values stored in this column.

required.description: Whether the column must be present in a valid row payload.

defaultValue.description: Optional default value applied when the implementer decides to materialize missing data.

isPrimaryKey.description: Whether this column is the declared primary key of the table.
